title: Polish Bitopological Groups and Polish Bitopological Groupoids
content: We introduce a framework for studying groups and groupoids equipped with two Polish topologies on their underlying sets. The principal objective is to combine the structural properties of topological groups and topological groupoids with the descriptive-set-theoretic features of Polish spaces. We dene Polish bitopological groups, Borel-compatible Polish bitopological groups, and Polish bitopological groupoids. We establish elementary permanence properties, formulate criteria for closed subgroups and products, and investigate the interaction between the two induced Borel structures. For groupoids, we examine the Polish structure of the space of composable arrows and the continuity of the structural maps with respect to each topology. Examples and counterexamples clarify the distinction between having two Polish topolo- gies and having two topologies that generate the same Borel sets. We conclude with several questions concerning descriptive set theory, orbit equivalence relations, and the extension of the framework to Polish groupoid actions.
